aboutP1: I’m Ever, a software engineer, a tinkerer, and a Rust evangelist in Rome. I’ve spent my career around systems that have to work: platform APIs at Anritsu, a weather system for the Italian Air Force, ML workflows at Qi4M. The stack changes; the job doesn’t: understand the thing, then make it legible to the next person.
aboutP2: I care about the seam between design and engineering. A good API, a clear error message, and a page that loads fast are the same craft in different clothes. Outside Anritsu, most of my work is Rust and TypeScript: Axum services, Postgres data models, and Astro and Svelte interfaces. I’m currently building BERLi, a work OS built on Rust that brings projects, timesheets, and HR into one place.
aboutP3: I write about Rust, infrastructure, and design. Away from the keyboard I’m a lifelong Linux user, a home-lab tinkerer, and a reader with more books and games than the Library page admits. I speak English, Spanish, and Italian. I’m happiest when I’m learning something new, preferably by taking it apart.

seoPrivacy: What this portfolio stores: cookieless analytics, article view counts and the feedback you send.
privacyIntro: This portfolio keeps only what it needs to run. There are no accounts, no advertising cookies and no third-party trackers. Game capsules in the Library are loaded from Steam's CDN, which receives the image request.
privacyAnalyticsBody: Page views are counted by a self-hosted Plausible instance at plausible.berli.app. It sets no cookies and stores no persistent identifier: only the page, the referrer, the country and the device type, in aggregate.
privacyFeedbackBody: Feedback on an article is stored by the API: the reaction, the article title, your message, the language and a hashed client IP used for rate limiting. Email delivery is best effort. Ask and it is deleted.
privacyViewsBody: Article views are counted per post without a user identifier. No profile is built from them.
privacyControllerBody: Ever Ruiz Diaz, Rome, Italy. The contact page lists the channels for any question, correction or deletion request.
